grh_c7d59b35fba422d53010.title: Dark Enchantress
paragraphs: In Algiers, Harry is drawn into a blackmail scheme involving the glamorous Magda Polarese and the mysterious Charles Bonquera. Detective Mike Nolan finally exposes the central trick: Magda and Charles are the same person, using a masculine disguise to blackmail women and her female persona to manipulate men. Harry helps turn the tables as the scheme collapses and Magda is taken into custody. A grateful Claremont gives Harry $5,000, which Harry surprisingly donates to the convent whose sisters had helped protect a young woman caught in the affair, while insisting Nolan keep the charitable gesture quiet to protect Harry's reputation.
